description: Generalize the proven Postgres review_jobs reliability model into a portable durable-job port and services/worker runtime while preserving Codecamp review behavior; bind handlers to capabilities only after the kernel is accepted.
deviation_notes: Task 1 was reopened by independent review on 2026-07-22 for build-context and coverage-evidence findings. Producer remediation and fresh independent re-review closed WKR-T1-H1 and WKR-T1-L1 with engine-level context proof, truthful combined coverage, quality gates, and exact-image runtime evidence. Parent-orchestrator acceptance completed Task 1. Task 2 then established a current executable review_jobs baseline: status-only settle CAS cannot distinguish a stale worker after reclaim/re-claim; admin replay resets every state by ID only and has no platform audit event. Historical acceptance evidence was reconciled against the current 15-minute visibility default and wired webhooks bootstrap. Tasks 3-5 and all Phase 2+ behavior remain pending/deferred.
